_doc: Character creation: lore shown on each page (CharacterCreation.gd). Draft text from the design docs (CLASS_PHILOSOPHIES, ELEDORIA_ATLAS) - edit freely.

Hume.lore: The children of every road. Humes settled the Radiant Plains first and everywhere after; what they lack in gifts they make up in stubbornness.

Ursari.lore: Bear-blooded folk of Bramblewood and Oakheart, slow to anger and slower to fall. Their elders say they were shaped from Elandria's first breath.
Ursari.summary: Tough and strong; hard to knock down.

Lycan.lore: Wolf-kin of Fangclaw and the Wildwood, who hunt in packs and settle quarrels with their teeth. Fenrisulfr's hunger runs in them.
Lycan.summary: Fierce and quick; built for the hunt.

Felis.lore: Cat-folk of Sunvale and the plains' edge: curious, graceful, and gone before you notice. Every Felis has a secret; most have several.

Kitsune.lore: Fox spirits of the Veiled Realm, where Tsukuyomi's mists hide paths that only they can walk. They grow a tail for every lesson the world teaches them.
Kitsune.summary: Clever and arcane; a gift for magic.

Elvarian.lore: Long-lived wardens of the Verdant Glades. They remember the forests before the roads, and they have not forgiven the roads.

Durgar.lore: Stone-hearted smiths of the Iron Hills and Forgehome, who measure a life in what it leaves behind. A Durgar's word is as good as their steel.
Durgar.summary: Sturdy and enduring; hard to wear down.

Drakoan.lore: Scaled folk of Wrathorn's Rage and Mount Infernia, said to carry a spark of the first fire. They run hot, in temper and in blood.

Djinn.lore: Spirits of wind and wish from the Enchanted Archipelago, half-bound to the world by promises older than they are.
Djinn.summary: Arcane and elusive; rides the wind.

Dhampyr.lore: Pale wanderers of the Gloomshroud, born between the living and the dead. Hel's shadow follows them, and most of them have made peace with it.
Dhampyr.summary: Resilient and dark-touched; drinks deep of life.

Paladin.blurb: Sword, shield and faith. Stands in front, takes the blows, and answers with Solara's fire.
Paladin.quote: In the light of Solara, we find our strength. In the darkness, we bring forth her dawn.

Samurai.blurb: A blade and a code. Calm until the moment to strike, then decisive.
Samurai.quote: In every swing of the sword, we honor our ancestors.

Berserker.blurb: Rage made flesh. The longer the fight, the harder they hit, and they heal by hitting.
Berserker.quote: In the rage of battle, we are reborn.

Monk.blurb: Fists and forms that mimic the beasts. Strikes often and flows between stances.
Monk.quote: To master oneself is to master the world.

Shinobi.blurb: Strike unseen. Poisons, elements and a knife in the dark.
Shinobi.quote: From the shadows we strike, unseen and unstoppable.

Myrmidon.blurb: Every weapon, mastered. Switches arms to fit the foe.
Myrmidon.quote: With steel in our hands and honor in our hearts, we forge our destiny.

Druid.blurb: Bear for strength, Alraune for healing. Nature's caretaker and its claws.
Druid.quote: In every leaf, in every beast, we see Elandria's touch.

Cleric.blurb: Heals and smites in the same breath. The party's beacon in mail armour.
Cleric.quote: With every prayer, we heal. With every strike, we deliver justice.

Kannagi.blurb: Speaks with the Eternal Ones: barriers, blessings and old, strange power.
Kannagi.quote: Through the whispers of the Eternal Ones, we find our strength.

Elementalist.blurb: Fire, ice, lightning, earth, and combos between them. Fragile, brilliant, a little mad.
Elementalist.quote: The elements are our allies, chaotic yet powerful.

Beastmaster.blurb: Pacts with legendary beasts; borrows their claws, wings and hide.
Beastmaster.quote: By Fenrisulfr's will, we are one with the wild.

Necromancer.blurb: Spends life to take life. Curses that bloom over time and the dead at their call.
Necromancer.quote: In the shadow of Hel, we find our power.

race: When Nyxara shattered, each of her pieces dreamed a people. Some of those dreams are still waking up.
The peoples of Nyxarys were born where the goddess fell - and most still live close to the part of her that made them.
class: The orders are older than the Guild. The Guild only gave them a ledger to sign.
Every order serves a god born from Nyxara's body - except the Kannagi, who serve what came before the gods.
origin: Nyxarys is Nyxara's body: her heart, her lungs, her bones. Where you were born decides which god watched your cradle.
Nexus stands on the wound where the Shattering began. The Tower rises from it, and no one knows how deep it goes.
world: The Guild of Nexus has a long memory. Some names in its ledger are still spoken; some are only carved on the wall.
Every adventurer in the Guild has a past - rivals, friends, feuds - before you ever walk in the door.
name: Names matter in Nexus. The bards only sing the ones they can remember.
One life, or many? The Guild takes both kinds - but only one kind becomes a Legend.
